subject: prd/installer
statement: When init or converge runs with the preview flag, the system shall report every write and external operation it would perform — for init, including the front-loaded check outcomes and the declared wiring operation set `prd:init-hardening` contracts — and perform none of them.
rationale: judgment before mutation (SCAF-1 dry-run parity); the audit found preview blind to the likeliest failures
fit_criterion: preview output enumerates the exact write/operation set — init runs additionally naming each check outcome and the declared wiring operations; the filesystem and remote state are untouched
